description_en: Validates the submitted rules without saving or enabling any policies. In IP_RANGE mode, the Cip parameter is used to simulate a client IPv4 or IPv6 address. The system checks for CIDR block matches first and then returns the matched rules. If no custom parameters are used, pass an empty JSON object {} for the top-level Args parameter. If no rules are matched, the Data field is empty or omitted. A successful API call does not indicate a policy match. This operation does not check for CIDR block conflicts with existing policies, perform A/AAAA query type filtering or weight sampling, or simulate the complete resolution chain such as legacy CIDR block configurations, line fallback, or Function Compute. After saving and enabling the policies, verify them by using the actual resolution API
description_zh: 验证本次提交的规则，不保存或启用任何策略。IP_RANGE 模式使用 Cip 模拟客户端 IPv4 或 IPv6 地址，先检查地址段匹配，再返回命中的规则；无自定义参数时，顶层 Args 传空对象的 JSON 文本 {}。未命中时 Data 为空或省略，接口调用成功不表示策略命中。本接口不检查与已有策略的地址段冲突，不进行 A/AAAA 查询类型过滤或权重抽样，也不模拟老地址段配置、线路回退、函数计算等完整解析链路。保存和启用后仍应通过实际解析接口验证
name: SdnsVerifyRuleCategory

parameters.help_en: The array of client CIDR blocks that must be provided in the IP_RANGE pattern. Send this parameter as a JSON form field. Do not pass this parameter in the LINE pattern. Supports single IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, CIDR blocks, and start-to-end ranges. Multiple entries have an OR relationship. For CIDR blocks, the IPv4 prefix length ranges from 0 to 32, and the IPv6 prefix length ranges from 0 to 128. Start-to-end ranges are inclusive and must belong to the same address family, with the start address not greater than the end address. Overlapping, containing, and duplicate ranges are allowed within the same policy. When the policy is saved and read back, the array sequence, duplicate items, and the original text of each string are preserved. The array can contain up to 2,000 array elements. The total number of parsed non-empty address expressions ranges from 1 to 2,000, including duplicates. Specify one expression per array element. It is compatible with line breaks within an array element. Each expression can contain up to 128 characters, including leading and trailing whitespace. The serialized UTF-8 JSON content cannot exceed 65,535 bytes. Both the quantity and byte limits apply simultaneously. To authenticate, the system only checks the ranges that you commit and does not check for conflicts with saved policies
parameters.help_zh: IP_RANGE 模式必须提供的客户端地址段数组，作为一个 JSON 表单字段发送。LINE 模式不传。支持 IPv4 和 IPv6 的单 IP、CIDR 或起止范围，多个条目之间为或关系。CIDR 的 IPv4 前缀为 0～32、IPv6 为 0～128；起止范围包含两端，必须属于同一地址族且起点不大于终点。同一策略内允许重复、包含和交叉，保存并回读时保留数组顺序、重复项及每个字符串的原文。数组元素最多 2000 个，解析后的非空地址表达式总数为 1～2000，重复项也计数。建议一个元素填写一条表达式；兼容元素内换行，每条表达式最多 128 个字符（含首尾空白）。序列化后的 UTF-8 JSON 内容不得超过 65535 字节，数量和字节限制同时生效。验证只检查当前提交的范围，不与已保存策略检查冲突
parameters.name: client_ip_ranges

parameters.help_en:
The match type. Valid values:
LINE: line mode
IP_RANGE: client CIDR block mode
If this parameter is omitted, LINE is used. In IP_RANGE mode, you must provide both ClientIpRanges and Cip
parameters.help_zh: 匹配类型：LINE 表示线路模式，IP_RANGE 表示客户端地址段模式。省略时按 LINE 处理。IP_RANGE 模式必须同时提供 ClientIpRanges 和 Cip
parameters.name: match_type

parameters.help_en: The simulated client IP address. This parameter is required in IP_RANGE mode. Supports a single IPv4 or IPv6 address. CIDR blocks and start-to-end ranges are not supported. This parameter is used for CIDR block matching in the current request and does not change the source of the actual DNS resolution request
parameters.help_zh: 模拟客户端 IP，IP_RANGE 模式必须提供。支持单个 IPv4 或 IPv6 地址，不接受 CIDR 或起止范围；用于本次地址段匹配，不改变真实解析请求来源
parameters.name: cip

fields.help_en: The optional list of custom parameter names, used to record the display order. Omit this parameter if you only match CIDR blocks. If you use Args, the names must correspond to the parameter names in Args
fields.help_zh: 可选的自定义参数名称列表，用于记录展示顺序。仅按地址段匹配时省略；使用 Args 时应与其中的参数名称对应
fields.name: arg_keys

fields.help_en: The optional custom parameter conditions. The key is the parameter name and the value is the match value. Omit this parameter if you only match CIDR blocks. You do not need to add business parameters
fields.help_zh: 可选的自定义参数条件，键为参数名，值为匹配值。仅按地址段匹配时省略，不需要添加业务参数
fields.name: args

fields.help_en: The rule name. This parameter is required and cannot be null. Use a non-empty name with business meaning. This parameter cannot replace the policy ID
fields.help_zh: 规则名称，必须提供，不能为 null。建议使用非空且有业务含义的名称；不能替代策略 Id
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The single destination IP address for the record. If Type is set to 1, specify an IPv4 address, such as 192.0.2.200. If Type is set to 28, specify an IPv6 address, such as 2001:db8::200. Do not use CIDR blocks, start-to-end ranges, or domain names
fields.help_zh: 记录对应的单个目标 IP。Type=1 时为 IPv4，例如 192.0.2.200；Type=28 时为 IPv6，例如 2001:db8::200。不使用 CIDR、起止范围或域名
fields.name: ip

fields.help_en:
The DNS record type. Valid values:
1: A record
28: AAAA record
Specify an integer. Do not use the strings A or AAAA
fields.help_zh: DNS 记录类型：1 表示 A 记录，28 表示 AAAA 记录。填写整数，不使用字符串 A 或 AAAA
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The auxiliary display text for the record type. This parameter does not participate in matching or resolution decisions and can be omitted in the request
fields.help_zh: 记录类型的展示辅助文本，不参与匹配或解析决策；请求中可以省略
fields.name: type_label

fields.help_en: The relative weight of the record. This parameter is used to select one record of the same query type only when ResultMode is set to 1. Set this parameter to a positive integer from 1 to 100. The sum of the weights of all records does not need to be 100. This parameter does not participate in selection when ResultMode is set to 0
fields.help_zh: 记录的相对权重，仅在 ResultMode=1 时用于选择同一查询类型的一条记录。建议设置 1～100 的正整数，各记录权重之和不必为 100；ResultMode=0 时不参与选择
fields.name: weight

fields.help_en: The list of configured DNS records, which can include A and AAAA records. Actual DNS resolution returns only records of the queried type. If the list is empty or does not contain records of the queried type, the system continues to fall back. This operation returns the records configured in the rule and does not filter them by query type
fields.help_zh: 配置的解析记录列表，可包含 A 和 AAAA。实际解析仅返回所查询类型的记录；列表为空或没有当前查询类型的记录时继续回退。本接口返回规则中配置的记录，不按查询类型过滤
fields.name: records

fields.help_en:
The record return mode. Valid values:
0: Returns all records of the queried type.
1: Returns one record of the queried type based on weight.
Policy validation only returns the rule configuration and does not perform weight sampling
fields.help_zh: 记录返回方式：0 表示返回所查询类型的全部记录，1 表示按权重返回所查询类型的一条记录。策略验证仅返回规则配置，不执行权重抽样
fields.name: result_mode

fields.help_en: The cache validity period of the record, in seconds. This parameter must be a positive integer
fields.help_zh: 记录的缓存有效期，单位为秒，必须为正整数
fields.name: ttl

parameters.help_en: The complete list of rules. This parameter is required and must contain at least one rule. If you only need to match CIDR blocks, configure a default rule without ArgKeys and Args, and configure the A/AAAA destination addresses in the Records field of this rule. This operation is used for match validation and does not save the rules
parameters.help_zh: 必须提供的完整规则列表，至少一条。仅按地址段匹配时配置一条不带 ArgKeys 和 Args 的默认规则即可，并在该规则的 Records 中配置 A/AAAA 目标地址。本接口用于匹配验证，不执行保存
parameters.name: rules

parameters.help_en: The parameter object used for the current validation. If no custom parameters are used, pass an empty JSON object {}. Do not pass an empty string or null
parameters.help_zh: 本次验证使用的参数对象。无自定义参数时也应传入空对象的 JSON 文本 {}；不要传空字符串或 null
parameters.name: args

Data.description_en: The configuration of the matched rule. If no rules are matched, this field is empty or omitted. This field does not represent the final response of the actual resolution chain
Data.description_zh: 命中的规则配置。未命中时为空或省略；不表示实际解析链路的最终响应

ArgKeys.description_en: The custom parameter names and their display order. This field can be empty if no custom parameters are used
ArgKeys.description_zh: 自定义参数名称及展示顺序；未使用自定义参数时可为空

items.description_en: A custom parameter name, which corresponds to a key in Args
items.description_zh: 一个自定义参数名称，与 Args 的键对应

additionalProperties.description_en: The match value for the corresponding custom parameter
additionalProperties.description_zh: 对应自定义参数的匹配值

Args.description_en: The custom parameter match conditions attached to the rule. If not configured, no parameter restrictions are attached
Args.description_zh: 规则附加的自定义参数匹配条件；未配置时不附加参数限制

Name.description_en: The rule name, used to identify the rule. This field cannot replace the policy ID
Name.description_zh: 规则名称，用于识别规则，不能替代策略 Id

Records.description_en: The list of configured DNS records, which can include A and AAAA records. Actual DNS resolution returns only records of the queried type. If the list is empty or does not contain records of the queried type, the system continues to fall back. This operation returns the records configured in the rule and does not filter them by query type
Records.description_zh: 配置的解析记录列表，可包含 A 和 AAAA。实际解析仅返回所查询类型的记录；列表为空或没有当前查询类型的记录时继续回退。本接口返回规则中配置的记录，不按查询类型过滤

Ip.description_en: The single destination IP address for the record. If Type is set to 1, specify an IPv4 address, such as 192.0.2.200. If Type is set to 28, specify an IPv6 address, such as 2001:db8::200. Do not use CIDR blocks, start-to-end ranges, or domain names
Ip.description_zh: 记录对应的单个目标 IP。Type=1 时为 IPv4，例如 192.0.2.200；Type=28 时为 IPv6，例如 2001:db8::200。不使用 CIDR、起止范围或域名

Type.description_en:
The DNS record type. Valid values:
1: A record
28: AAAA record
Specify an integer. Do not use the strings A or AAAA
Type.description_zh: DNS 记录类型：1 表示 A 记录，28 表示 AAAA 记录。填写整数，不使用字符串 A 或 AAAA

TypeLabel.description_en: The auxiliary display text for the record type. This parameter does not participate in matching or resolution decisions and can be omitted in the request
TypeLabel.description_zh: 记录类型的展示辅助文本，不参与匹配或解析决策；请求中可以省略

Weight.description_en: The relative weight of the record. This parameter is used to select one record of the same query type only when ResultMode is set to 1. Set this parameter to a positive integer from 1 to 100. The sum of the weights of all records does not need to be 100. This parameter does not participate in selection when ResultMode is set to 0
Weight.description_zh: 记录的相对权重，仅在 ResultMode=1 时用于选择同一查询类型的一条记录。建议设置 1～100 的正整数，各记录权重之和不必为 100；ResultMode=0 时不参与选择

ResultMode.description_en:
The record return mode. Valid values:
0: Returns all records of the queried type.
1: Returns one record of the queried type based on weight.
Policy validation only returns the rule configuration and does not perform weight sampling
ResultMode.description_zh: 记录返回方式：0 表示返回所查询类型的全部记录，1 表示按权重返回所查询类型的一条记录。策略验证仅返回规则配置，不执行权重抽样

Ttl.description_en: The cache validity period of the record, in seconds. This parameter must be a positive integer
Ttl.description_zh: 记录的缓存有效期，单位为秒，必须为正整数

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, used to troubleshoot call issues. This field is not the policy ID
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的标识，用于排查调用问题，不是策略 Id
